keywords: Sequences and sums 2.Recurrence relations 3.Differentiation 4.Graphs of functions 5.Integration
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn about the sums of sequences. (2) Learn about recurrence relations (3) Learn about the differential coefficients and derivatives. (4) Learn about the graphs of functions. (5) Learn about indefinite and definite integrals of functions.
advice: This is a basic course of calculus. We will cover the following materials. 1. Sequences and their Limits 1.1 Limits of Sequences 1.2 Sums of Sequences 1.3 Recurrence relations 2. Differentiation 2.1 Limits of Functions 2.2 Differential Coefficients and Derivatives 2.3 Derivative Formulas 2.4 Differentiation of Composite Functions 2.5 Function Increase and Decrease and Extreme Values 3. Integration 3.1 Indefinite Integration 3.2 Definite Integration Classes include exercises and quizzes, and a final examination at the end of the semester. Daily preparation and review are important. Students are required to solve designated tasks. Students should study reports and research topics in a planned manner, and strictly avoid plagiarism. Students should actively use the teachers' office hours and the Math. and Science Education Research Center.
books: Textbooks: Mathematics for Information Science A (Calculus) [kanazawa Institute of Technology] Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of mathematics (Formula calculation, exponential/ logarithmic/trigonometric functions, etc.) Basic Excel skills.

Be able to find the derivatives of basic functions.
Be able to draw the graphs of basic functions.
Be able to find the indefinite and definite integrals of basic functions.
Understand the meanings of fundamental english words for mathematics.
Try to understand the contents, and be able to complete the tasks within the deadlines.
